verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud-based design tool whose files 'live in the cloud', so data residency is a fair question, but no evidence documents a way to choose a storage region or residency. The self-hosted export only packages a published scene for hosting elsewhere; it is an adjacent export feature, not a control over where editor data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
